short: The New Deal National Recovery Administration.
note: The United States National Recovery Administration, created in 1933 to promote recovery through industrial codes governing competition, wages, and working conditions. Its emblem was a blue eagle.

sources.label: National Archives: National Industrial Recovery Act

short: The world-encircling mountain of Islamic cosmology.
note: Qāf, the legendary mountain encircling the earth in medieval Islamic geographical traditions, often described as emerald and bordering the unknown regions beyond the inhabited world.

short: Possibly the Chinese immigrant name Gold Mountain.
note: Possibly Gold Mountain, or Gum San, the Chinese name associated with California after the gold discoveries that drew nineteenth-century emigrants across the Pacific.

sources.label: National Park Service: China Beach and Gold Mountain

short: Depression-era migrants from the southern Great Plains.
note: A frequently derogatory name applied to migrants from Oklahoma and other southern Great Plains states, many driven west during the Dust Bowl and Great Depression.

sources.label: Library of Congress: The Migrant Experience

note: Incapable of failing or wearing out.
Helpers doing basic kitchen work, especially cleaning pots and dishes.
